Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: ACME Security Questionnaire: SIG/CAIQ kickoff & a few clarifications

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can get the SIG/CAIQ started:

- Redwood will share a completed SIG-lite (spreadsheet) and our standard SOC 2 status summary.
- If ACME prefers the full SIG or a CAIQ, we can adapt — please confirm which form you want completed.
- We requested a HubSpot deal + a shared Drive folder for document exchange (links below).

A couple of clarification questions we had while preparing:
1) Data residency: is ACME OK with logs and monitoring metrics being stored in us-west-2 (we can provide EU hosting if required)?
2) Scope: do you need coverage for both Hosted API and Private (on-prem) deployments, or just the Hosted API for the initial evaluation?
3) Timebox: what timeline are you targeting for returning the completed questionnaire (2 weeks / 10 business days / other)?

Attached is a short "SIG request" workbook that maps which form you prefer and where we typically have supporting evidence. I copied Camila (solutions engineer) and Dev (infosec) to help answer technical evidence questions.

Suggested next steps:
- Confirm which questionnaire (SIG full/CAIQ/custom).
- Confirm scope (Hosted vs Private).
- We'll deliver first-pass responses within 5 business days after confirmation.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if that helps.

Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Request_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Redwood_Security_Deck_v3.pdf (presentation stub)

From: Rachel O'Connor <rachel.o@acme-corp.com>

Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 18:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME Security Questionnaire: SIG/CAIQ kickoff & a few clarifications

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear recap. ACME is comfortable starting with the full SIG (we will ask for CAIQ only if our cloud team requests the additional mapping). A few answers and clarifications from our side:

- Data residency: for POCs, us-west-2 is fine, but for production we prefer EU for EU customer data. We may ask for proof of region tagging in logs.
- Scope: initially we only need Hosted API coverage; we may expand to Private later.
- Timeline: 10 business days would be ideal. We have a security review meeting on Nov 18 where we'd like to have your completed SIG.

Two follow-up questions for you:
A) Do you have a completed SOC 2 Type II report or a bridge letter available?
B) For encryption at rest key management, can you list which KMS providers you integrate with (AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, customer-managed HSM)?

Appreciate you looping Camila and Dev. Please put any evidence files in the shared Drive link and we will route to our security team.

Best,
Rachel
Director, Security & Compliance
ACME Corp

Hi Rachel —

Quick answers to your questions (happy to provide supporting evidence files into the Drive):

A) SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for our Hosted API (period: Apr 2025 - Sept 2025). I can share a redacted copy under NDA; alternatively we can provide the SOC 2 bridge letter plus the auditor contact for verification.

B) KMS / encryption: For Hosted API we use AWS KMS (primary). We also support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and have integrations for Google Cloud KMS for specific private deployments. We can support HSM-backed key storage via customer-managed configurations in our Private offering.

Additional notes:
- Logs: we can provide region-tagged access logs and a sample retention policy.
- On multi-tenancy: Hosted API is logically multi-tenant but we provide tenant isolation controls and clear data handling documentation.

Action items I will take after this thread:
- Upload SOC 2 summary + redacted report to Drive under /ACME-Security.
- Start filling the SIG spreadsheet (first pass).
- Confirm list of files ACME needs for evidence (e.g., penetration test report, architecture diagram).

If you want, we can also schedule a 30-min technical review on Tue or Wed to walk through evidence and any custom mappings.

Thanks,
Dev Patel

dev.patel@redwood.com
